address: Shop 103, 172 Zhoumen Street, Liwan, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: The room isn’t any different from your typical noodles joint, but its glazed noodles ‘factory’ definitely puts on a great show. Watch the skilful noodle-maker knead the dough with a bamboo pole to develop ultra-bouncy texture. House-made duck egg noodles can be paired with shrimp wontons, pork wontons, braised beef brisket, pork trotters. Also try those tossed in lard and shrimp roe....
